roads.name: Wupatki and Sunset Crater loop road
words: Sweeping and steady: 33 curves in 7.5 miles.
From 6,311 to 7,086 ft, with 1,341 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 84°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 20 mph limit its corners ask for only about 0.10 g, so the limit, not the curves, sets the pace.

roads.name: Snow Bowl Road
words: Properly twisty: 11 curves in 2.1 miles, about 5 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 8,590 to 9,306 ft, with 710 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 75°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 30 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.44 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: North Snow Bowl Road
words: Properly twisty: 23 curves in 2.6 miles, about 9 a mile.

From 7,716 to 8,603 ft, with 894 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 79°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 30 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.31 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Prescott–Flagstaff Highway
words: Properly twisty: 41 curves in 7.6 miles, about 5 a mile.
The 5 miles at the south end are tamer.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 5,094 to 6,433 ft, with 2,355 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
19 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 89°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 40 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.25 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
